# UI Development Guidelines

Remix + React + Tailwind CSS UI for Pantry Planner.

- Use pnpm for package management.
- Follow the existing mobile-first and accessibility conventions.
- Run `pnpm --filter pantry-planner-ui lint` and `pnpm --filter pantry-planner-ui typecheck` before committing.

```bash
pnpm --filter pantry-planner-ui lint
pnpm --filter pantry-planner-ui typecheck
pnpm --filter pantry-planner-ui build
```
